'''Pax system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|system]] of the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]] that included the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Plagen]] and the [[Karbonni asteroid belt]] where the third planet in the system used to be.
